review.rationale: AF-CTR-03 part A1a, review fix round 2 (delta review of 61e8e4d): a transaction whose callback panics is rolled back and its connection given back (D1/D8); a COMMIT without an answer of an auxiliary transaction (rate-limit counts and reservations, flow attempts, refusal audits) is reported as an unavailable store and only the call's effect write as an unknown outcome (D10); a right e-mail code whose sign-in failed in the store gets its failure reservation back (D2); the anonymous failures' audit marker is kept per class (D3); a lost race for a new installation is a store contention that gives the flow attempt back (D4); the auth_flow_outcome comment of migration 0002 states the refusal of a succeeded and of an exhausted flow (D6, no SQL change, a new checksum before any deployment applied it). No Worker source, module, package, base image, toolchain or legal file changes.
